description: Runs the same RSS → social posts flow as the Flomixy app for an article already in a connected feed: one AI-written caption per target network (with the article link and the feed image, same as the app's "AI variants"). Never publishes directly: without scheduledAt the posts stay DRAFTS; with scheduledAt they are scheduled but still wait for human approval. Pick times with get_best_times / get_next_free_slot. Must be at least 10 minutes from now, otherwise SCHEDULED_TOO_SOON (not retryable; the error names the earliest allowed time). Get feedId/itemId from list_rss_feeds and accountId from list_accounts. Each network uses one AI caption unit; networks that cannot be generated (duplicate caption, account not owned by the feed's brand, or the article is already posted/scheduled/drafted on that very account: reason ALREADY_POSTED with `existingPostId` and `existingStatus`) come back in `skipped`, not as an error; no AI unit is spent for them. Use `force` only if the user wants another post anyway. Requires scope POSTS_WRITE.

approverId.description: Workspace member who should review the posts (list_approvers).

force.description: Set true ONLY when the user explicitly wants another post for an article that already has one on the account. Default false: such networks come back in `skipped` with reason ALREADY_POSTED.

itemId.description: Item id from list_rss_feeds. Exactly one of itemId / itemUrl.

itemUrl.description: Link of an article already in the feed (e.g. the blog URL). Exactly one of itemId / itemUrl.

targets.description: One post is generated per entry.

accountId.description: Connected account id (list_accounts). It must belong to the brand of the feed.

channel.description: Network of the account, canonically UPPERCASE (e.g. FACEBOOK); lowercase is accepted.

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 WITH timezone offset. Omit to leave this network's post as a draft.

name: generate_posts_from_rss_item
title: Generate social posts from an RSS / blog item
